page_title: Nextpad++ for Mac and Linux: Free Native Text and Code Editor, Full Notepad++ Port

summary.name: Nextpad++
summary.one_liner: Nextpad++ is a free, open-source native port of the Windows Notepad++ text and code editor for macOS and Linux.
use_cases: Editing and writing code on macOS or Linux
Running Notepad++ features without Windows or Wine
Viewing two documents side by side
Automating repetitive text edits with macros
Compressing and extracting archives on macOS
summary.what_it_does:
Nextpad++ is a text and code editor built on the Scintilla editing component, written in Objective-C++ for macOS and C++ with GTK4 for Linux. It supports syntax highlighting for 80+ programming languages, customizable color themes, user-defined languages, and 137 interface languages. Search includes regular expressions, find in files, bookmarks and incremental search. Users can record, save and replay macros, and view or edit two documents or two parts of one document side by side. The page also describes a plugin ecosystem (Plugin Admin) with Windows plugins being ported over time, and bundles NextZip for archive handling.</what_it_does>
